fund_type: An open-ended equity linked saving scheme with a statutory lock-in of 3 years and tax benefit under Section 80C

lock_in_period.description: Mandatory 3-year (36 months) lock-in period from the date of allotment for each installment. Units cannot be redeemed, transferred, or switched out during the lock-in period.

expense_ratio.description: The Total Expense Ratio (TER) for HDFC ELSS Tax Saver Fund Direct Plan - Growth is 1.09%.

exit_load.description: Nil. No exit load is charged for redemption after the completion of the statutory 3-year lock-in period.

investment_limits.description: The minimum SIP investment is ₹500 and in multiples of ₹500. The minimum lump sum investment amount is ₹500 for initial as well as additional purchases.

taxation.tax_deduction: Investments qualify for tax deduction under Section 80C of the Income Tax Act up to ₹1.5 Lakh per financial year.
taxation.short_term_capital_gains: Not applicable as redemption is locked for 3 years.
taxation.long_term_capital_gains: LTCG above ₹1.25 Lakh per financial year upon redemption after 3 years is taxed at 12.5% without indexation.

operations.account_statement_procedure: Tax saving investment certificates (80C proofs) and account statements can be downloaded via Groww Profile > Reports > Capital Gains & Tax Reports or via HDFC MF website.
operations.folio_lookup: Check registered folio in Groww dashboard or monthly consolidated account statements (CAS).
